subject: spanish

moments.title: Franco dies
moments.body: Franco dies in November 1975. Juan Carlos I becomes king.
moments.takeaway: Dictatorships sometimes end with their leader's death.

moments.title: Constitution approved
moments.body: Spain's first democratic constitution since the 1930s establishes a parliamentary monarchy with autonomous communities.
moments.takeaway: Constitutional design encoded both democracy and regional diversity.

moments.title: 23-F coup attempt
moments.body: Civil guards seize the Cortes. Juan Carlos's televised address against the coup is credited with saving democracy.
moments.takeaway: Constitutional monarchy survived its closest test.

now.title: Democracy today
now.body: Juan Carlos abdicated in 2014 amid scandal; Felipe VI succeeded. Spain's parliamentary democracy faces pressure from both regionalism and economic crisis.
now.open_questions: What is the future of Spain's 1978 settlement?

reflection: Spain's democracy is younger than many other European countries'.
